meta.title: Image Transform Lite — Batch image processing for macOS
meta.description: Native macOS Apple Silicon app for batch image processing. 8 transformations, live preview, reusable presets. Free and open source.
meta.ogTitle: Image Transform Lite — Batch image processing for macOS
meta.ogDescription: Batch processing with live before/after preview, drag-and-drop, and reusable presets. Free and open source.

hero.subtitle: Native macOS Apple Silicon app. 8 transformations, live preview, and batch processing with reusable presets.

import.title: Import
import.description: Pick the folder with your images. Recursive search across subfolders is supported.

configure.title: Configure
configure.description: Enable the transformations you need and reorder them with drag-and-drop.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: See the before/after in real time as you tweak each parameter.

export.title: Export
export.description: Process the full batch and export to WebP, JPEG, PNG or TIFF preserving folder structure.

features.title: Everything you need to process images
features.subtitle: A complete toolkit for photographers, designers, and content creators on macOS.

live-preview.title: Live preview
live-preview.description: See the before/after result in real time, with 150ms debounce on every parameter change.

drag-and-drop.title: Drag-and-drop
drag-and-drop.description: Reorder the transformation pipeline by dragging cards, powered by Sortable.js.

presets.title: JSON presets
presets.description: Save combinations as reusable recipes. Import/export them as JSON files.

batch.title: Batch processing
batch.description: Process whole folders recursively while preserving the original directory structure.

multi-format.title: Multi-format
multi-format.description: Reads JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, and TIFF. Exports to WebP, JPEG, PNG, or TIFF with configurable quality.

auto-update.title: Auto-update
auto-update.description: Detects new versions from GitHub Releases, downloads them, and prepares the installation.

sidebar.title: Collapsible sidebar
sidebar.description: Maximize workspace. The sidebar collapses to 48px with contextual tooltips.

open-source.title: Open source under AGPL-3.0
open-source.description: Auditable, no telemetry, no accounts. Built with Python and Pillow.

transformations.title: 8 transformations, infinite combinations
transformations.subtitle: Each transformation runs in the order you choose.

rotate.title: Rotate
rotate.description: Rotate any angle from -360° to 360° with transparent background.

crop.title: Safe Square Crop
crop.description: Smart square crop that preserves opaque corners after a rotation.

resize.title: Resize
resize.description: Resize by percentage (10-500%) or fixed dimensions with optional aspect ratio.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.description: Add text as a watermark: size, opacity and position (4 corners or center).

download.title: Download Image Transform Lite
download.subtitle: macOS Apple Silicon (arm64). Free and open source.

pkg.title: .pkg installer
pkg.description: Double-click and it installs automatically into /Applications.

zip.title: .zip archive
zip.description: Unzip and move the app to /Applications manually.

download.requirements: Requires macOS 11 or later. Apple Silicon (arm64).
download.gatekeeperNote: First launch: right-click → Open (the app isn't signed with an Apple Developer certificate).

footer.tagline: Batch image processing for macOS. Free, open source, no telemetry.
footer.rights: Free software: you can use, study, share and improve it.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.
